metadata.title: Log in | Slashie
metadata.description: Log in to Slashie to post tasks, send quotes, and manage your local marketplace account.

en.asideTitle: Get local tasks done with confidence.
en.asideDescription: Post a task, compare quotes from nearby workers, and manage everything in one place.
en.title: Log in to Slashie
en.description: Manage requests, quotes, and worker tools from one account.
en.deletionScheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}. Sign in before then to restore it.
en.deletionScheduledNoDate: Your account will be deleted in 30 days. Sign in before then to restore it.
en.restoreNotice: Sign in to restore your account. You'll be asked to confirm.
en.trustNote: Your account helps keep task details, quotes, and worker profiles secure.

messages.securityCheckRequired: Complete the security check to continue.
messages.securityCheckFailed: Security check failed or expired. Complete it again and retry.
messages.rateLimited: Too many attempts right now. Please wait a bit and try again.
messages.networkError: Can't reach Slashie. Check your connection and try again.

metadata.title: 登入 | Slashie
metadata.description: 登入 Slashie，發佈任務、傳送報價，並管理你的本地服務帳戶。

zh_hk.asideDescription: 發佈任務、比較附近 worker 的報價，並在同一處管理所有事項。
zh_hk.title: 登入 Slashie
zh_hk.description: 用一個帳戶管理請求、報價和 worker 工具。
zh_hk.deletionScheduled: 你的帳戶將於 {date} 刪除。在此之前登入即可還原。
zh_hk.deletionScheduledNoDate: 你的帳戶將於 30 天後刪除。在此之前登入即可還原。
zh_hk.restoreNotice: 登入即可還原你的帳戶，系統會請你確認。
zh_hk.trustNote: 你的帳戶有助保障任務詳情、報價及 worker 個人檔案的安全。

messages.securityCheckFailed: 安全檢查失敗或已逾時，請重新完成後再試。
messages.rateLimited: 嘗試次數過多，請稍後再試。
messages.networkError: 無法連接 Slashie，請檢查網絡連線後再試。
